## 2. データ処理

```{r}

library(sjmisc)  # add_rowsのために追加
library(data.table)

data_list <- list()

for (yr in yearlist) {
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("ENDES データ結合処理開始:", yr, "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n\n")

  root_folder <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", yr) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws()
  
  year_data <- readRDS(file.path(root_folder, "data_merged.rds"))
  # 初回のみラベル抽出 → Excel 書き出し（前ターンの関数）
  # export_labels_to_excel(
  #   df = year_data,
  #   dataset_name = "year_data",
  #   path = file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","data_dictionary.xlsx")
  # )
  
  year_data <- strip_all_labels(year_data) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(hhid))
  
  print(paste("Processing year:", yr, "with", nrow(year_data), "records"))
  
  data_list[[yr]] <- year_data
}

# ******************************************************************************
# 全ての年次データの結合
all_data_merged <- rbindlist(data_list, fill = TRUE, ignore.attr = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()

print(paste("Total records:", nrow(all_data_merged)))

# 重複チェック
duplicate_check(all_data_merged, c("year", "caseid"), "all_data_merged")
# ******************************************************************************

# 分析用の共通変数の読み込み
endes_keys <- read_rds(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_keys.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(v026, v024, v025, v001, v002, v003))

# 2005/2006のデータが特殊なため、キーを正規化してマージする
# 正規化済みキーを新しい列として作成
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    hhid_trim = str_trim(hhid),
    year_trim = str_trim(year)
  )

endes_keys <- endes_keys %>%
  mutate(
    hhid_trim = str_trim(hhid),
    year_trim = str_trim(year)
  )

# 共通キーでマージ
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  left_join_safe(endes_keys, c("year_trim", "hhid_trim"), diagnose = TRUE)

# 元のキー列（hhid, year）のみを残す
# 正規化キー列（hhid_trim, year_trim）は削除
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(hhid_trim, year_trim)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x")) %>%
  mutate(v024 = as.numeric(v024))

# ******************************************************************************
# 食品摂取量データの統合（キー：department*urban*income）
# ******************************************************************************
# 食品群消費データの読み込み

  df_food_org <- readRDS(
    file.path(gdrive_enaho_dir, "food_consumption_by_area_income.rds"))
  # 初回のみラベル抽出 → Excel 書き出し（前ターンの関数）
  # export_labels_to_excel(
  #   df = df_food_org,
  #   dataset_name = "df_food_org",
  #   path = file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","data_dictionary.xlsx")
  # )
  
  df_food_org <- strip_all_labels(df_food_org) %>%
    dplyr::select(-ends_with("_se")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-starts_with("se.")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("area_income")) %>%
    mutate(inc_quintile = as.numeric(as.character(inc_quintile))) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(
    .fn   = ~ paste0("enaho_", .x),  # 列名ベクトル .x に prefix を付与
    .cols = starts_with("fbdg_")    # "fbdg_" で始まる列だけを対象
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(
      .fn   = ~ paste0("enaho_", .x),  # 列名ベクトル .x に prefix を付与
      .cols = starts_with("fg_")    # "fg_" で始まる列だけを対象
    ) 

# ******************************************************************************
# 食品消費データ結合
# ******************************************************************************
# lv を完全に外して素の numeric にする関数
drop_lv_numeric <- function(x) {
  x2 <- unclass(x)              # lv など全クラスを外す
  as.numeric(x2)                # 純粋な numeric に
}

# 食品摂取量データの結合
all_data_merged2 <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    v024             = as.numeric(v024),
    dm_rural         = as.numeric(dm_rural),
    dm_wealth_class  = as.numeric(dm_wealth_class)
  )

df_food_org2 <- df_food_org %>%
  mutate(
    department   = as.numeric(department),
    inc_quintile = as.numeric(inc_quintile)
  )

# join 直前ステップ：キー列の lv を完全に剥がす
all_data_merged3 <- all_data_merged2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    v024            = drop_lv_numeric(v024),
    dm_rural        = drop_lv_numeric(dm_rural),
    dm_wealth_class = drop_lv_numeric(dm_wealth_class)
  )

df_food_org3 <- df_food_org2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    department   = drop_lv_numeric(department),
    dm_rural        = drop_lv_numeric(dm_rural),
    inc_quintile = drop_lv_numeric(inc_quintile)
  )

# 型確認（ここで両方とも numeric だけになっているかチェック）
str(all_data_merged3[, c("v024", "dm_rural", "dm_wealth_class")])
str(df_food_org3[, c("department", "inc_quintile")])

# numeric 同士で join
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged3 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_food_org3,
    by = c("v024" = "department",
           "dm_rural",
           "dm_wealth_class" = "inc_quintile")
  )

all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>% 
  # stuntingデータの欠損値除去
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(nt_ch_stunt)) %>%
  
  # 介入群グループ化
  mutate(
    treatment_group = case_when(
      treatment_start == "2010" ~ 1,  # 早期介入
      treatment_start == "2012" ~ 2,  # 後期介入
      TRUE ~ 0                        # コントロール
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_grp = case_when(
      treatment_group == 0 & year < 2010  ~ "control_pre(<2010)",
      treatment_group == 0 & year >= 2010  ~ "control_post(>=2010)",
      treatment_group == 1 & year < 2010  ~ "treat_pre",
      treatment_group == 1 & year >= 2010  ~ "treat_post",
      treatment_group == 2 & year < 2012  ~ "treat_pre",
      treatment_group == 2 & year >= 2012  ~ "treat_post"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_grp = factor(analysis_grp, 
                          levels =c("control_pre(<2010)", "treat_pre",
                                    "control_post(>=2010)", "treat_post"))  
  )

# 不要な属性をクリンナップ
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  strip_all_labels()
  
# ================================================================================
# 2. sampling weightの年次補正
# ================================================================================
# 年ごとの元 v005 合計を算出

year_totals <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_v005 = sum(v005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成前に変数を変換
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    v021 = as.numeric(v021),                # Primary Sampling Unit
    v022 = as.character(haven::as_factor(v022)) #haven_labelledをfactorに変換してからcharacter
  )

# 正規化済みサンプリングウェイトの作成
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("total_v005"))) %>% # 存在する場合のみ削除
  dplyr::left_join(year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # 元のDHSウェイト
    dhs_weight = v005 / 1e6,
    # 年次正規化係数：全期間対象の標本サイズ比 (例：年の全体ウェイト比)
    year_norm = total_v005 / sum(year_totals$total_v005),
    # 正規化済みウェイト
    sampling_weight_norm = dhs_weight / year_norm,
    # 極端値トリミング
    sampling_weight_trimmed = pmax(
      pmin(sampling_weight_norm,
           quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
      quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dhs_weight, -year_norm, -total_v005, -treatment_start)  # 中間変数は削除

# 1. 元のhaven_labelledデータから変換
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.labelled), labelled::to_factor)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(v021) & !is.na(v022) & !is.na(sampling_weight_trimmed))


new_labels <- c(
  v024 = "department code",
  dm_rural = "rural/urban residence",
  dm_wealth_class = "wealth class",
  age_months = "child age in month",
  analysis_grp = "treated status (control-pre/post and treatment-pre/pos)",
  caseid = "Case Identification",
  child_alive = "is child alive?",
  group_treated = "hh category by treatment assignment (control, treat1, treat2))",
  hhid = "household id",
  juntos_non_participation = "participate in juntos program: no",
  juntos_participation = "participate in juntos program: yes",
  living_with_mother = "child living with mother",
  ms_age = "Age at first marriage",
  nt_ch_waz = "weight for age",
  rc_tobc_any = "Uses any type of tobacco - smoke or smokeless",
  rc_tobc_anysmkless = "Uses any type of smokeless tobacco",
  rc_tobc_osmkless = "Uses other type of smokeless tobacco",
  rc_tobc_snuffm = "Uses snuff smokeless tobacco by nose",
  rc_tobv_betel = "Uses betel quid with tobacco",
  rh_anc_neotet = "Protected against neonatal tetanus",
  sampling_weight_norm = "normalized sampling weight",
  sampling_weight_trimmed = "normalized sampling weight (trimmed extreme)",
  state = "name of state",
  treated_status = "treated status for staggered did",
  year_treated = "year of treatment implementation",
  v021 = "Primary sampling unit",
  year = "year of treatment implementation",
  treatment_group = "treatment group (0=control, 1=early, 2=late)"
)

# ここ☝papeR::labels(all_data_merged, which = names(new_labels)) <- unname(new_labels)



# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ファイルをRDSで保存
saveRDS(all_data_merged, file = file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", 
        "all_data_merged_temp1.rds"))

print("データ結合処理完了")

print("結合結果（NAの分布）")
colnames <- names(all_data_merged)
colnames <- colnames[grepl("^[a-zA-Z]{2}_", colnames)] 
row_num <- nrow(all_data_merged)
na_summary_year <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(colnames), ~ round(sum(100*is.na(.x))/row_num, 1))) 

m <- apply(na_summary_year, 2, as.numeric)  # 数値マトリクスに
m <- t(m)  # 転置
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(m), 
           file = file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "all_data_merged_na_summary.xlsx"),
           rowNames = TRUE)
print(m)
```
